title: Financial Reporting Effects of the 1934 Securities Exchange Act
eligible_reason: Single common treatment date: the 1934 Securities Exchange Act (Post = fyear > 1934 for all firms), with Treat = NYSE firm that did not report sales in 1932. Tables 3-8 estimate reghdfe y c.post##c.treat with firm (and year) FE, so the design is a 2x2 DiD with one adoption date, not staggered. Table 9 spillovers add a triple interaction with ade.
design_notes: Code.sas lines 864, 1090-1186: Treat = (no sales reported in 1932), Post = (fyear > 1934); reghdfe dv_std c.post##c.treat [controls] absorb(permno fyear) cluster(...); b1934.fyear##c.treat event study (single date); entropy-balanced [aw=_weight] variants in robustness.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Post = fyear > 1934 for every firm (main.sas7bdat: Post = 0 for 1930-1934, 1 for 1935-1938).
data_files_note: README: all data needed to reproduce results included (CRSP-derived variables plus hand-collected Moody's Manuals data).
software_notes: Stata 17 (reghdfe) for tables; SAS 9.4 for data construction (Stata code embedded in Code.sas).
screener_notes: Published PDF read (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2024.06043.pdf via data/text). Regression inventory empty because Stata code sits inside Code.sas.
